# PLG Reel Pack

Input required: track title, 2-line theme, target platform (TikTok / Shorts / Reels).

Output these files (create if missing):
- ugc-scripts/packs/{slug}.md
- prompts/packs/{slug}-visual.md

Each pack must include:
1. 5 hooks under 8 words
2. On-screen text timeline (0-3s, 3-8s, 8-15s, last 3s CTA)
3. Caption with 1 CTA and 8 hashtags max
4. CapCut steps that only reference EASY-MODE + existing presets
5. Thumbnail text (max 4 words)

Tone: grateful, urgent, clean. No clickbait that contradicts the faith-rooted brand.
